questions.stem: Let f(x) = |x − 5|. Which input among 2, 4, 7 and 9 gives the smallest value of f?
questions.explain: f(2) = 3, f(4) = 1, f(7) = 2 and f(9) = 4. The smallest is f(4) = 1.

questions.stem: What is the straight-line distance between the points (1, 1) and (7, 9)?
questions.explain: The differences are 6 and 8, so the distance is √(36 + 64) = √100 = 10.

questions.stem: In 4-fold cross-validation on 80 samples, one fold is held out for validation in each round. How many samples are used for training in a round?
questions.explain: Each fold has 80 ÷ 4 = 20 samples. Training uses the other 3 folds: 80 − 20 = 60.
